bibl.title: A crowning achievement.
bibl.note: Part I. Wreaths in the ancient world: Introduction; - "Put on your crown": the beginning; - Floral wreaths; - Metal wreaths; - Types of wreaths; - Wreaths in context (a. Athletic games; - b. Honorary items; - c. Decorative motifs on pieces of art and inscriptions; - d. Death; - e. Love and marriage; - f. Symposia and celebrations; - g. Sacrifices); - Christian Iconography. - Part II. Wreaths in Egypt - Evidence from the papyri: The term στέφανος in papyri; - Wreaths in Egypt; - Material of wreaths in papyri; - Political and religious life; - Honors in persons and Gods; - Magic papyri. - Conclusion.
